comments.text:
GOAL: Views and commands should be parameterized by device capabilities, not hardcode them. This makes the codebase more maintainable and theoretically portable to other Roland SysEx devices.

Identified in global audit: routing_page.rs, surround_page.rs, tone_editor.rs, tone_selector.rs all embed INTEGRA-7-specific constants (output names, FX types, room types, tone banks, part structure) directly in view code.

title: refactor: extract device specification layer from hardcoded view/CLI data
